description: IOG share of active network stake on the Leios cluster. Most panels read db-sync directly, where leios_committee weight is the raw stake fraction so no denominator is needed. Two panels still need Mimir, for IOG vote coverage and per-seat vote coverage, which have no db-sync equivalent since its vote tables are all governance. Set the $dbsync datasource to a db-sync Postgres instance.

panels.title: Hours since last on-chain certification
panels.description: Age of the most recent block carrying a Leios certificate, from db-sync leios_cert_signer. Ground truth for whether Leios is certifying at all, and the best thing here to alert on.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((extract(epoch from (now() - max(b.time))) / 3600)::numeric, 2)
       AS "hours since last cert"
FROM leios_cert_signer s
JOIN block b ON b.id = s.block_id

panels.title: Next epoch in
panels.description: Time until the next epoch boundary, when the stake snapshots rotate and mark becomes set. Epoch length is derived from the mean start to start delta of the last 10 epochs rather than hardcoded, so this stays correct on clusters with a different epoch length. Boundaries jitter by a few tens of seconds because epoch.start_time is the first block of the epoch, not the scheduled slot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM block),
     len AS (
       SELECT round(avg(d)) AS secs FROM (
         SELECT extract(epoch from (lead(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY no) - start_time)) AS d
         FROM epoch, tip WHERE no BETWEEN tip.e - 10 AND tip.e
       ) x WHERE d IS NOT NULL
     )
SELECT extract(epoch from (e.start_time + make_interval(secs => len.secs::int) - now()))
       AS "next epoch in"
FROM epoch e, tip, len
WHERE e.no = tip.e

panels.title: db-sync lag
panels.description: Seconds between the newest block db-sync has processed and now. Almost every panel here is computed from db-sync, so this is the trust check: if it climbs, the numbers are stale rather than falling.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch from (now() - max(time))) AS "db-sync lag" FROM block

panels.title: IOG own vote coverage
panels.description: Share of votable points the IOG pools actually voted on, at $vantage. The one number here that db-sync cannot supply: its vote tables are all governance, nothing per-seat. Falls independently of stake share, and participation drops if it does.

panels.title: Smallest single-pool share
panels.description: Lowest of the individual IOG pool weights in the current epoch. Colour bands were removed rather than left stale: they were the old per-pool equivalents of a 60 percent group target, and a static threshold cannot follow $iog_watermark. For the per-pool target compare against the ADA to add per pool table, which divides the group watermark across its pools.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(lc.weight) AS "smallest pool"
FROM leios_committee lc
JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = lc.pool_hash_id
WHERE lc.epoch_no = (SELECT max(epoch_no) FROM block)
  AND ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})

panels.title: IOG stake share, current epoch
panels.description: Share of active network stake held by the IOG group in the CURRENT epoch, ie the ledger's `set` snapshot, which is what drives committee weight and leader election right now. A delegation change does not appear here until it rotates in at an epoch boundary; use the stake snapshots panel to see it coming one epoch ahead in `mark`.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM block),
     -- amt is ADA throughout, converted once here
     s AS (SELECT es.pool_id, sum(es.amount) / 1e6 AS amt
           FROM epoch_stake es, tip WHERE es.epoch_no = tip.e GROUP BY es.pool_id),
     g AS (SELECT s.pool_id, s.amt,
             CASE WHEN ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})         THEN 'IOG'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir0_pools:sqlstring})        THEN 'PIR0'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir_cluster_pools:sqlstring}) THEN 'PIRC'
                  ELSE 'REST' END AS grp
           FROM s JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = s.pool_id),
     tot AS (SELECT sum(amt) AS total,
                    sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'REST') AS rest FROM g),
     -- REST is the group we do not set, so it fixes the network total:
     -- T = REST / (1 - sum of the three group watermarks)
     tgt AS (SELECT tot.total, tot.rest,
                    tot.rest / (1 - $iog_watermark - $pir0_watermark
                                - $pir_cluster_watermark) AS t
             FROM tot)
SELECT sum(g.amt)::numeric / nullif(tgt.total, 0) AS "IOG share"
FROM g, tgt WHERE g.grp = 'IOG' GROUP BY tgt.total

                  ELSE 'REST' END AS grp

panels.title: Certified EBs per epoch, on-chain
panels.description: Blocks carrying a Leios certificate, by epoch. Zero means nothing certified in that epoch at all, which has happened on this cluster for several consecutive epochs, so a flat zero stretch is a real outage rather than a gap in the data. Read it with the hours since last certification stat above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(b.time) AS "time", count(DISTINCT s.block_id) AS "certified EBs"
FROM block b
LEFT JOIN leios_cert_signer s ON s.block_id = b.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time)
GROUP BY b.epoch_no
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Certification weight per epoch, on-chain
panels.description: Min, mean and max certificate weight per epoch. Certification fires the instant the threshold is crossed, so the recorded signer set is the minimal crossing set and these hug 75 percent, which shows that a block certified rather than by how much margin. Weights are joined to the committee of the epoch the votes were cast in, not the epoch of the carrying block: a cert may be carried up to minCertificationGap, 10 slots, later and so cross a boundary. Without that correction, a cert carried by the first block of an epoch is scored against the wrong committee and mis-reads as below threshold. Corrected, none has been observed below the threshold.

targets.rawSql:
WITH efs AS (SELECT epoch_no, min(slot_no) AS fs FROM block GROUP BY epoch_no),
     cw AS (
       SELECT b.epoch_no, b.time, s.block_id, sum(lc.weight) AS w
       FROM leios_cert_signer s
       JOIN block b ON b.id = s.block_id
       JOIN efs ON efs.epoch_no = b.epoch_no
       JOIN leios_committee lc
         ON lc.seat_index = s.seat_index
        AND lc.epoch_no = CASE WHEN b.slot_no - efs.fs < 10
                               THEN b.epoch_no - 1 ELSE b.epoch_no END
       WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time)
       GROUP BY b.epoch_no, b.time, s.block_id
     )
SELECT min(cw.time) AS "time",
       round((min(cw.w) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "min %",
       round((avg(cw.w) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "avg %",
       round((max(cw.w) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "max %"
FROM cw
GROUP BY cw.epoch_no
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: IOG stake share over time
panels.description: IOG committee weight per epoch, from leios_committee, exact. The flat line is the $iog_watermark target, returned by the query rather than set as a threshold so it follows the variable. Grafana thresholds are fixed numbers and cannot reference a variable, which is why the earlier coloured bands were removed: they were calibrated for a 60 percent target and became misleading once the target moved. Steps at epoch boundaries because weight is constant within an epoch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.start_time AS "time",
       sum(lc.weight)              AS "IOG stake share",
       $iog_watermark::numeric     AS "iog_watermark target"
FROM leios_committee lc
JOIN epoch e ON e.no = lc.epoch_no
JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = lc.pool_hash_id
WHERE ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(e.start_time)
GROUP BY e.no, e.start_time
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stake share per IOG pool
panels.description: Per-pool committee weight by epoch. Labels prefer off_chain_pool_data.ticker_name, populated since offchain_pool_data was enabled on this db-sync, and fall back to a hardcoded IOG map if a pool has no fetched metadata.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.start_time AS "time",
       coalesce(o.ticker_name,
                CASE ph.view
                  WHEN 'pool1kye7409qnlnk2wwnqj5qfr7m0xqns7kk0s09echrnejtud5nred' THEN 'IOG1'
                  WHEN 'pool1t72gcvkxfzrzzzxt55ms29rn3ejv86yzp8cep8k8eml9gtypldm' THEN 'IOG2'
                  WHEN 'pool1jljl9rkjqk0e3spad2d0tucgml4qeqjqecxk290jdn2lxuawt5s' THEN 'IOG3'
                  ELSE left(ph.view, 14) || '...'
                END) AS metric,
       lc.weight AS value
FROM leios_committee lc
JOIN epoch e ON e.no = lc.epoch_no
JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = lc.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- off_chain_pool_data gains a row per metadata re-fetch, so it holds
  -- several rows for some pools.  Joining it raw fans out and duplicates
  -- pools in this panel.  Keep only the newest row per pool.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pool_id) pool_id, ticker_name
  FROM off_chain_pool_data ORDER BY pool_id, id DESC
) o ON o.pool_id = ph.id
WHERE ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(e.start_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stake share against forged share
panels.description: Both exact and on-chain, per epoch. Forged share persistently above stake share means other pools are losing blocks that IOG is not, which has run persistently positive by several points across every multi-epoch window measured so far.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT b.epoch_no,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring}))::numeric
           / nullif(count(*),0) AS forged
  FROM block b
  JOIN slot_leader sl ON sl.id = b.slot_leader_id
  LEFT JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = sl.pool_hash_id
  WHERE sl.pool_hash_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.epoch_no
), s AS (
  SELECT lc.epoch_no, sum(lc.weight) AS share
  FROM leios_committee lc
  JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = lc.pool_hash_id
  WHERE ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY lc.epoch_no
)
SELECT e.start_time AS "time", s.share AS "stake share", f.forged AS "forged share"
FROM s JOIN f ON f.epoch_no = s.epoch_no
JOIN epoch e ON e.no = s.epoch_no
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.start_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total ADA to add, all groups
panels.description: Additional stake needed across the IOG, PIR0 and PIR1-10 groups to reach their watermarks, in ADA. The total is anchored on the rest-of-SPOs group, which is not set here: T = REST / (1 - iog - pir0 - pir_cluster). Groups already at or above target contribute zero rather than a negative, so this is what to add, not a net position. Computed against the newest snapshot, `mark`, rather than the current epoch, since stake sent now lands in a future snapshot and mark is the closest estimate of where it will settle.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM epoch_stake),
     -- amt is ADA throughout, converted once here
     s AS (SELECT es.pool_id, sum(es.amount) / 1e6 AS amt
           FROM epoch_stake es, tip WHERE es.epoch_no = tip.e GROUP BY es.pool_id),
     g AS (SELECT s.pool_id, s.amt,
             CASE WHEN ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})         THEN 'IOG'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir0_pools:sqlstring})        THEN 'PIR0'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir_cluster_pools:sqlstring}) THEN 'PIRC'
                  ELSE 'REST' END AS grp
           FROM s JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = s.pool_id),
     tot AS (SELECT sum(amt) AS total,
                    sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'REST') AS rest FROM g),
     -- REST is the group we do not set, so it fixes the network total:
     -- T = REST / (1 - sum of the three group watermarks)
     tgt AS (SELECT tot.total, tot.rest,
                    tot.rest / (1 - $iog_watermark - $pir0_watermark
                                - $pir_cluster_watermark) AS t
             FROM tot)
SELECT round(greatest(
         ($iog_watermark          * tgt.t - coalesce(sum(g.amt) FILTER (WHERE g.grp='IOG' ),0))
       + ($pir0_watermark         * tgt.t - coalesce(sum(g.amt) FILTER (WHERE g.grp='PIR0'),0))
       + ($pir_cluster_watermark  * tgt.t - coalesce(sum(g.amt) FILTER (WHERE g.grp='PIRC'),0))
       , 0)) AS "ADA to add"
FROM g, tgt GROUP BY tgt.t

panels.title: ADA to add per pool, by group
panels.description: Per-pool top-up for every pool in the IOG, PIR0 and PIR1-10 groups. Each group's watermark is split equally across its pools. `ADA to add` clamps at zero, so a pool already above target shows 0 and its overshoot is visible by comparing `stake now` against `target`. Rounded to whole ADA. Computed against the newest snapshot, `mark`, not the current epoch.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM epoch_stake),
     -- amt is ADA throughout, converted once here
     s AS (SELECT es.pool_id, sum(es.amount) / 1e6 AS amt
           FROM epoch_stake es, tip WHERE es.epoch_no = tip.e GROUP BY es.pool_id),
     g AS (SELECT s.pool_id, s.amt,
             CASE WHEN ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})         THEN 'IOG'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir0_pools:sqlstring})        THEN 'PIR0'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir_cluster_pools:sqlstring}) THEN 'PIRC'
                  ELSE 'REST' END AS grp
           FROM s JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = s.pool_id),
     tot AS (SELECT sum(amt) AS total,
                    sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'REST') AS rest FROM g),
     -- REST is the group we do not set, so it fixes the network total:
     -- T = REST / (1 - sum of the three group watermarks)
     tgt AS (SELECT tot.total, tot.rest,
                    tot.rest / (1 - $iog_watermark - $pir0_watermark
                                - $pir_cluster_watermark) AS t
             FROM tot),
     n AS (SELECT grp, count(*) AS pools FROM g GROUP BY grp),
     per AS (SELECT g.pool_id, g.grp, g.amt,
                    CASE g.grp
                      WHEN 'IOG'  THEN $iog_watermark         * tgt.t / n.pools
                      WHEN 'PIR0' THEN $pir0_watermark        * tgt.t / n.pools
                      WHEN 'PIRC' THEN $pir_cluster_watermark * tgt.t / n.pools
                    END AS target
             FROM g JOIN n ON n.grp = g.grp, tgt
             WHERE g.grp <> 'REST'),
     ocpd AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pool_id) pool_id, ticker_name
              FROM off_chain_pool_data ORDER BY pool_id, id DESC)
SELECT coalesce(o.ticker_name, left(ph.view, 14) || '...') AS "pool",
       per.grp                                             AS "group",
       round(per.amt)                                      AS "stake now (ADA)",
       round(per.target)                                   AS "target (ADA)",
       round(greatest(per.target - per.amt, 0))            AS "ADA to add"
FROM per JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = per.pool_id
LEFT JOIN ocpd o ON o.pool_id = per.pool_id
ORDER BY 5 DESC, 2, 1

panels.title: Defunding candidates, worst first
panels.description: Every seat in the current committee ranked by on-chain participation over the last $offender_epochs epochs. `forged` versus `exp` is blocks produced against the number its stake implies, computed per epoch so a pool that joined mid-window is not unfairly penalised. `cert sign %` is the share of certificates in the window whose signer set included this pool, and it discriminates well, spreading the committee between pools that sign none and pools that sign most. It undercounts a pool that votes but arrives late, because only the minimal set that crossed the threshold is recorded, so treat a low value as suggestive rather than proof of not voting. `faucet idx` is the stake key index to pass to `just dedelegate-pools`. A pool with forge ratio near zero AND cert sign 0 is doing nothing for density or certification.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM block),
     win AS (SELECT (SELECT e FROM tip) - $offender_epochs AS lo, (SELECT e FROM tip) AS hi),
     epb AS (SELECT b.epoch_no, count(*) AS n FROM block b, win
             WHERE b.slot_leader_id IS NOT NULL AND b.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi
             GROUP BY b.epoch_no),
     ept AS (SELECT es.epoch_no, sum(es.amount) AS tot FROM epoch_stake es, win
             WHERE es.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi GROUP BY es.epoch_no),
     exp AS (SELECT es.pool_id, sum(es.amount::numeric / ept.tot * epb.n) AS expected
             FROM epoch_stake es
             JOIN ept ON ept.epoch_no = es.epoch_no
             JOIN epb ON epb.epoch_no = es.epoch_no, win
             WHERE es.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi GROUP BY es.pool_id),
     forged AS (SELECT sl.pool_hash_id, count(*) AS n
                FROM block b JOIN slot_leader sl ON sl.id = b.slot_leader_id, win
                WHERE b.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi AND sl.pool_hash_id IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY sl.pool_hash_id),
     tcert AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.block_id) AS n FROM leios_cert_signer s
               JOIN block b ON b.id = s.block_id, win WHERE b.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi),
     certs AS (SELECT s.pool_hash_id, count(DISTINCT s.block_id) AS n
               FROM leios_cert_signer s JOIN block b ON b.id = s.block_id, win
               WHERE b.epoch_no BETWEEN win.lo AND win.hi GROUP BY s.pool_hash_id),
     seats AS (SELECT lc.pool_hash_id, lc.seat_index, lc.weight FROM leios_committee lc, tip
               WHERE lc.epoch_no = tip.e),
     vk AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (hash_id) hash_id, leios_vkey FROM pool_update
            ORDER BY hash_id, registered_tx_id DESC, id DESC),
     faucet AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.addr_id) f.key::int AS idx, d.pool_hash_id
                FROM faucet_stake_addr f JOIN stake_address sa ON sa.view = f.value
                JOIN delegation d ON d.addr_id = sa.id ORDER BY d.addr_id, d.id DESC)
SELECT s.seat_index AS seat,
       coalesce(o.ticker_name, left(ph.view,12)||'..') AS pool,
       round((s.weight*100)::numeric,2) AS "wt %",
       coalesce(f.n,0) AS forged, round(e.expected,0) AS "exp",
       round((coalesce(f.n,0)/nullif(e.expected,0))::numeric,2) AS "forge ratio",
       round((100.0*coalesce(c.n,0)/tcert.n)::numeric,0) AS "cert sign %",
       CASE WHEN vk.leios_vkey IS NULL THEN 'NO_VKEY' ELSE '' END AS vkey,
       coalesce(fa.idx::text,'-') AS "faucet idx"
FROM seats s JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = s.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- off_chain_pool_data gains a row per metadata re-fetch, so it holds
  -- several rows for some pools.  Joining it raw fans out and duplicates
  -- pools in this panel.  Keep only the newest row per pool.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pool_id) pool_id, ticker_name
  FROM off_chain_pool_data ORDER BY pool_id, id DESC
) o ON o.pool_id = ph.id
LEFT JOIN forged f ON f.pool_hash_id = s.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN exp e ON e.pool_id = s.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN certs c ON c.pool_hash_id = s.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN vk ON vk.hash_id = s.pool_hash_id
LEFT JOIN faucet fa ON fa.pool_hash_id = s.pool_hash_id
CROSS JOIN tcert
ORDER BY "cert sign %" NULLS FIRST, "forge ratio" NULLS FIRST
LIMIT $offender_rows

panels.title: Vote coverage by seat, point in time
panels.description: Vote coverage per committee seat at $vantage over the last $window, worst first, from Mimir. Deliberately an instant table and not a timeseries: seats are reassigned to different pools every epoch, so a series drawn across epoch boundaries is a rotating cast of pools rather than one pool's behaviour. Read it with the seat column of the defunding table above to identify who currently holds each seat. A per-pool view across epochs is not possible today: vote counts live in Mimir keyed by seat while the seat to pool map lives in db-sync, with no shared key. The fix is not an Alloy change, since Alloy only sees logs and neither the weights nor the pool mapping appear in any log line. It needs the per-epoch seat to pool map and weight exported from db-sync as a metric, after which this becomes a native PromQL group_left join. Seats that have never voted have no series at all and are absent here rather than shown as zero.

panels.title: Stake snapshots, current and pending
panels.description: Group shares for each of the three ledger stake snapshots, from db-sync epoch_stake. Naming verified against cardano-cli query stake-snapshot: stakeGo is the previous epoch, stakeSet the current tip, stakeMark the next. So `set` drives committee weight now and `mark` takes effect at the next boundary, which is where a delegation change first shows up. All three rows are always listed. `mark` shows as pending for roughly the first 45 minutes of an epoch because db-sync populates epoch_stake for the next epoch part way in rather than at the boundary; epoch_stake_progress.completed tracks that insert.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tip AS (SELECT max(epoch_no) AS e FROM block),
     want AS (SELECT g.epoch_no, g.role FROM tip, LATERAL (VALUES
                (tip.e - 1, 'go, previous epoch'),
                (tip.e,     'set, current epoch'),
                (tip.e + 1, 'mark, next epoch')) AS g(epoch_no, role)),
     s AS (SELECT es.epoch_no, es.pool_id, sum(es.amount) / 1e6 AS amt
           FROM epoch_stake es
           WHERE es.epoch_no IN (SELECT epoch_no FROM want)
           GROUP BY es.epoch_no, es.pool_id),
     g AS (SELECT s.epoch_no, s.amt,
             CASE WHEN ph.view IN ($${iog_pools:sqlstring})         THEN 'IOG'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir0_pools:sqlstring})        THEN 'PIR0'
                  WHEN ph.view IN ($${pir_cluster_pools:sqlstring}) THEN 'PIRC'
                  ELSE 'REST' END AS grp
           FROM s JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = s.pool_id),
     agg AS (SELECT epoch_no,
                    round(100.0 * sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp='IOG')  / sum(amt), 3) AS iog,
                    round(100.0 * sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp='PIR0') / sum(amt), 3) AS pir0,
                    round(100.0 * sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp='PIRC') / sum(amt), 3) AS pirc,
                    round(100.0 * sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE grp='REST') / sum(amt), 3) AS rest,
                    round(sum(amt)) AS total
             FROM g GROUP BY epoch_no)
SELECT want.role       AS "snapshot",
       want.epoch_no   AS "epoch",
       agg.iog         AS "IOG %",
       agg.pir0        AS "PIR0 %",
       agg.pirc        AS "PIR1-10 %",
       agg.rest        AS "rest %",
       agg.total       AS "total (ADA)",
       CASE WHEN agg.epoch_no IS NULL
            THEN 'pending, db-sync writes this part way into the epoch'
            ELSE 'written' END AS "status"
FROM want LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.epoch_no = want.epoch_no
ORDER BY want.epoch_no

panels.title: Red team pool mode
panels.description: Which service each leiosred host is running over time, from node_exporter's systemd collector. Node and Piranha conflict in systemd so exactly one can be active. Off means neither is active, which covers stopped, failed and mid-restart, so a persistent Off band is worth chasing. A long Piranha band on a pool that is meant to be forging is the failure this panel exists to catch.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
    max by (instance) (node_systemd_unit_state{instance=~"leiosred[0-9]+-bp-.*", name="cardano-node.service", state="active"})
  + max by (instance) (node_systemd_unit_state{instance=~"leiosred[0-9]+-bp-.*", name="cardano-leios-piranha.service", state="active"}) * 2,
  "pool", "PIR$1", "instance", "leiosred([0-9]+)-bp-.*")

list.description: Rate window. 2h spans the 1h on / 1h off load cycle so the series never gaps. 30m can land entirely in an idle hour and return no data.
list.name: window

list.description: The db-sync Postgres datasource, defaulted to dbsync-leios. Required by the on-chain certification panels; the rest of the dashboard works without it. Point it at the cexplorer database on a leios db-sync host.
list.name: dbsync

list.description: Vantage host for the coverage panel. Every node sees every vote, so this must be a single instance or counts multiply by the fleet size. Prefer a client host such as dbsync, faucet or centrifuge; block producers observe far fewer votes and are a poor vantage point.
list.name: vantage

list.description: The three IOG pool ids, used by the db-sync top-up panels to identify IOG stake in epoch_stake. Far more stable than a hand-maintained stake figure: these ids only change if IOG re-registers a pool.
list.name: iog_pools

list.description: How many epochs back the defunding table looks. 8 epochs is 2 days at 6h per epoch.
list.name: offender_epochs

list.description: Rows shown in the defunding table.
list.name: offender_rows

list.description: Target share for the IOG pools. The three watermarks must sum to less than 1; the remainder is the rest-of-SPOs share.
list.name: iog_watermark

list.description: Target share for PIR0 on its own.
list.name: pir0_watermark

list.description: Target share for PIR1-10 combined, split equally across the ten.
list.name: pir_cluster_watermark

list.description: PIR0's pool id, kept separate from the cluster so it can carry its own watermark.
list.name: pir0_pools

list.description: The ten PIR cluster pool ids sharing one watermark.
list.name: pir_cluster_pools
